acceptedArchitectureBasis: ADR-0018 sections 1-3, 7-10: Provider-agnostic service, DeepSeek/deepseek-v4-flash initial disabled default, explicit-context-only boundary
Accepted Design V1.4 sections 13.6, 14.3 A-07, 19.5: reject Provider/model/endpoint override and include deepseek in the Provider literal boundary

historicalFailureEvidenceOnly.role: regression mapping only; never architecture or implementation authority

techM01Disposition.rootCorrection: every rule carries its complete closed gapSetAst and counters inside this sole selected registry; no global admitted insertion fallback, second gap table, witness deletion list or consumer-local classifier exists

canonicalization.serialization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme semantics over this parsed JSON document
canonicalization.collisionOrder: globally unique ascending integer priority 1..32; lower number wins
canonicalization.profileLink: registryId+registryVersion+SHA-256 must equal the sole Owner-selected registry tuple in the corrected Design; absent, multiple or mismatched selections fail closed

astSchema.characterClassGrammar: optional leading ^, then only literal ASCII characters, ASCII ranges x-y, \\s, \\d or \\p{N}; dangling escapes, reverse/overlapping ranges and all other property/class forms fail closed
astSchema.repetitionGrammar: integer min >= 0; max is null or integer >= min; repetitions preserve historical unbounded maxima only where max is null
astSchema.referenceGrammar: references resolve only to the exact definitions map; missing, recursive or unused definitions fail closed
astSchema.boundaryGrammar: wordBoundary and startAnchor are zero-width; lookbehind/lookahead operands must be one unicodeProperty, shorthand or charClass atom

gapSetAstSchema.codePointGrammar: uppercase U+ followed by exactly 4..6 hexadecimal digits encoding one Unicode scalar value
gapSetAstSchema.referenceGrammar: references resolve only inside this selected registry's gapSetDefinitions; missing, recursive or unused definitions fail closed
gapSetAstSchema.semantics: set membership is evaluated by ECMAScript Unicode property escapes under the profile's exact runtime tuple; subtract is left-set minus right-set

insertionTransform.soleGapAuthority: rule.insertion.gapSetAst plus its inline counters in this selected registry; gapPolicyId is audit metadata and never resolves through a second table
insertionTransform.invalidControlAuthority: gapSetDefinitions.invalid-control-set-v1; invalid_control precedence is evaluated before all grammar transitions
insertionTransform.pathSemantics: expand literals to Unicode scalar atoms; alternation selects one branch; sequence concatenates; repetition contributes atom adjacencies inside and between iterations; groups are transparent; zero-width assertions never consume or create a gap
insertionTransform.directForm: run the same canonical transition IR with every inserted-transition counter fixed to zero
insertionTransform.insertionAwareForm: run the same canonical transition IR with each rule's validated inline gapSetAst, per-gap counter and total counter
insertionTransform.structuredForm: structured rules use the same canonical transition IR; structuredRecognizerId is audit metadata only
insertionTransform.overflowSemantics: a complete skeleton accepted only when a per-gap or total counter is relaxed returns unsupported_value under the selected exact limits; unrelated text remains allow
insertionTransform.compilerContract: validate grammar AST and gap-set AST together, lower once to one canonical transition graph, and execute direct, insertion-aware, structured and overflow modes from that graph

deepSeekDecision.securitySemantics: DeepSeek as a whole provider token and deepseek- as a model-family prefix are category provider_override in direct and insertion-aware modes; deepseek-v4-flash is therefore rejected
deepSeekDecision.rationale: preserves the accepted Provider/model override boundary and ADR-0018 initial Provider/model decision

providerModelRegistrationClosure.rule: before any future Provider/model adapter or configuration can be approved, every normalized provider token and model-family prefix in that approved registry must be covered by the selected grammar with category provider_override; otherwise configuration resolution and the architecture gate fail closed
